system.description: With manic depression, your periods of depression are interrupted by brief (a matter of days at most) periods of mania with heightened energy and a general disregard for consequences. The depressive stages are similar in all ways to depression ▶225. When manic, you will take risks, spend wildly, and engage in behavior without forethought or consideration of long-term consequences.

effects.description: Similar to depression, but when manic you must make a WIL Check to stop yourself from undertaking a risky endeavor. You will also try to convince others to go along with the idea.
